title: Pandas Sheet
blurb: Twenty-five hands-on exercises that cover the everyday pandas toolkit on realistic tables: messy exports, event logs, sensor feeds, sales ledgers and training metrics. You go from building and inspecting a DataFrame to cleaning it, summarising it by group and reshaping it between long and wide.
prereq: You should be able to write Python functions using lists, dicts and loops; no previous pandas experience is needed.
next: Continue with the NumPy plan to see the array machinery under every DataFrame, or the SQL plan to express the same joins, groupings and windows in a database, then put the skills to work in Cracking ML.
